$schema_note: C3 machine summary for item 1 (round18 L3-ornaments closeout). Human record: round19/C3/RESULTS.md. Ledger fragments: round19/C3/ledger.json.

gate_G_A2_band_shaped_control.note_LP2: LP2 is the typeface of all 56 target pages; templates.npz was clustered from LP2 renders, so LP1 is out of domain.
gate_G_A2_band_shaped_control.truth_attribution: flat-stream: band reads concatenated in reading order and aligned once to the page's flat canonical rune stream, because the corpus breaks lines semantically and the image breaks them typographically. Per-line matching would measure the transcriber's paragraph breaks.

stratified_by_reader_own_RUNIC_call.disclosure: The RUNIC rule (cost_median<=300, degeneracy<0.60) was fixed in round18 before any band was read. The decision to REPORT along this axis is post-hoc and is disclosed.

specificity.note: Both false positives are <=7 glyphs. Round 18 measured no specificity at all.

confusion_le16_glyphs.bound: At <=16 glyphs a RUNIC call is right about 3 times in 4 and its glyphs are then essentially verbatim; a NON-RUNIC call at that size carries NO information. No band is asserted to be decoration on the strength of a failed read.

kill_condition.rule: >=50% of known non-rune ink called RUNIC

P_9_refutation.claim_under_test: the 30 catalogued bands with n<=16 GLYPHS are the only real candidates
P_9_refutation.reason: `n` in ornaments.json is a Round 8 row-group count, not a glyph count.
P_9_refutation.genuinely_tiny_bands: B001/B005/B009 (1 component, 42x21 px, read 'GI'/'G?' at degeneracy 0.50) and B048/B049 (1 component, 39x8 px) - single vine hairlines.
P_9_refutation.only_real_short_content: B096 (p50) and B098 (p51), the alphanumeric base-60 token blocks: 16 CHARACTERS = eight two-character [0-4][0-9A-Za-z] tokens, reads confirmed byte-for-byte by two independent vendored community transcriptions.
P_9_refutation.defect_class: Same class as the dropped y coordinate round18 found in the same file: the artifact's schema was never checked against what its consumers assumed it meant.

H1.register_conditional: ENGLISH-ONLY. Recognizer is English + a known-Cicada-string list; per round18 L7-A that register scores 0.33 Latin, 0.00 vowel-dropped English.

H7.decoy_conclusion: a set of six integers drawn AT RANDOM clears the family bar by two orders of magnitude, so the null is invalid for every set including the ladder

ordinary_text_control.note: ordinary typeset text rejects uniformity ~100 orders of magnitude more strongly than the bands do; a page of text sits in a column

hypotheses.summary: No claim of a hit survives in the H1-H8 family.

confound_test.conclusion: bimodality SURVIVES and strengthens; the book really has two row-height states

correlations.explained_by: mean GLYPH WIDTH: runes_per_line~width rho=-0.653 p=8.26e-75; mean_rune_idx~width rho=+0.367 p=9.49e-21; PARTIAL runes_per_line~mean_rune_idx|width rho=-0.018 p=0.661
correlations.conclusion: wider runes, fewer runes per justified line. A typesetter, not a channel.

control_C3a_power_ceiling.meaning: the fill_ratio negative is bounded at an 85.9% power ceiling; recovery saturates and never reaches the bar at any separation up to 8 sd

control_C3b_decoder_validation.meaning: the 8/8 bit-decode failures are a property of the CHANNEL, not of the decoder

B_12_line_geometry.verdict: NEGATIVE with a stated power ceiling

round18_control.consequence: round18's 1098 reported outliers were uninterpretable in BOTH directions

H9_ink_intensity.diagnosis: detect() estimated the page body mean and sd from a set that INCLUDED the planted components; lifting 40 of ~270 body components by 40 grey levels inflates sd from ~1.4 to ~15, so a planted component's z becomes 2.7, below the 4-sigma bar. The plant destroyed its own null.
H9_ink_intensity.repair: addendum #2: the addendum's RULE is unchanged (>4 sigma above the page body-text distribution, stroke-width-and-height-matched re-test); only the ESTIMATOR changes, from mean/sd to median/1.4826*MAD (50% breakdown point). A repair to the instrument, not a relaxation of the bar.

discriminator.question: is being flagged predicted by render geometry?
discriminator.verdict: PARTIALLY EXPLAINED - number reported, no claim made

H9_ink_intensity.status: The channel is now MEASURABLE for the first time (that is the contribution). It is NOT a demonstrated channel.

page15_anomaly.what: the `3299` grey observation that prompted addendum #1, now quantified
page15_anomaly.why_not_a_confound: the four are the same height and width as their neighbours, so the stroke-width-and-height-matched re-test cannot explain them; and the repaired detector recovers a planted 2-level lightening at recall 1.000, so a 51-level difference is 25x inside its power envelope
page15_anomaly.interpretation: four adjacent glyphs on one row is the width of a four-digit number, consistent with the `3299` entry of the 4x4 grid
page15_anomaly.CRITICAL_LIMIT: established as a property of THIS RENDER, NOT of the document

second_render_test.conclusion: the same file, not a second encode - no independent render of page 15 exists in this repository

page15_anomaly.reopen_if: obtain a second independent render of page 15 (a different mirror's JPEG, a PNG, or the original PDF) and re-measure the four component boxes above. Cheapest open item in the lane; either answer is worth having.

conditionals.object_space: the 109 records Round 8's grouping emitted; the rejection rule is now known to carry at least two schema defects (dropped y; an `n` that is not a glyph count), so its output is NOT a complete frame for the book's non-text ink
conditionals.decoder_transition_model: R9 template DP, 29-class bijection, templates clustered from LP2. LP1 measurably out of domain (42.6% vs 95.6%). Non-Futhorc systems, glyphs below ~30 px, and glyphs absent from templates.npz are outside the model entirely
conditionals.adjudicator_register: H1 is English + known-Cicada-string only (power 0.33 Latin / 0.00 vowel-dropped English per L7-A). H2-H8 and B-12 are register-free

not_covered: band content in a non-English register (H1 only)
whether the page-15 anomaly is in the document rather than in this JPEG
non-binary encodings of the row-height bimodality
whether a short band called NON-RUNIC is decoration or misread runes (sensitivity 0.50 at that size)
reopen_conditions: a second render of page 15 (cheapest open item in the lane)
re-run the ornament grouping with its rejection thresholds swept and read whatever new boxes appear
extend templates.npz with LP1-clustered templates and re-run G-A2; if LP1 rises to LP2's level the pooled gate may pass
re-adjudicate H1 through Round 19's I2 multi-register panel - its negative is English-only
